name: Saeki Mashiro
source:
She's the eldest daughter of Kirinomori Shrine and a demonic priestess.

She is a forward-looking, natural girl who looks young but is bright, energetic, and has a relaxed atmosphere, she loves sweets and has a pet named Sunekosuri (Sue), whom she met while exterminating ghosts in the past.
She has a younger sister named Momiji who seems more mature than her.

Her main weapon is a fan.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.debonosu.jp/debo/game/reimeiki_21/index.html]official website[/url]]
